Vendored page libraries of the aad viewer. Served by server.py under /vendor/; the page makes no network calls.
Every package came from the npm registry tarball (npm pack <name>@<version>) on 2026-11-11. All are MIT; each folder keeps the package's own LICENSE file.
No code from GPL or AGPL projects is included.
